evidence_source: J-GLOBAL Japanese Plant Taxonomy Society 24th meeting proceedings
implication: A 2025 study explicitly investigated the origin of C. boninense using genetic information; the method, raw-data accession and reusable sequence matrix were not recovered from the accessible metadata.
